body: RaKai REACTS to Reggie’s NEW music video filmed right outside the AMP house, and things have gone TOO FAR this time… After watching the footage, RaKai didn’t hold back his reaction, calling Reggie out and saying, “Reggie stop playing w/ me bro this has gone to far” Reggie tried making references in the song that he could relate with RaKai in certain circumstances even though these rumours have been NOT TRUE. Is Reggie in crash out mode? kaicenat rakai.
